title: PCSO lotto results Nov. 17: ₱549.58M jackpot not won
summary: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱549.58 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the other major lottery jackpots in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱549.58 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the other major lottery jackpots in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 51-56-30-20-29-34, with a jackpot prize of ₱549.58 million. No ticket matched
